notes: Release date from the official research.meta.ai page header (August 5, 2026; matches OpenRouter created and Zuckerberg announcement). Release status verified (page fetched in headless browser); all 3 evidence rows pending because every benchmark value on the launch post is an image. Co-training facts from the post text: model trained on rejection-sampled harness trajectories, recipe optimizations for goals/compaction/subagents, Muse Code toolset integrated; Spark 1.1 generated the challenging coding environments used to build 1.2's training set. Kernel-optimization case study (KDA 68.7% speedup / MLA 61.1% speedup over 1,000+ tool calls, 24h runs vs provided baselines) recorded here as context only — speedup-vs-baseline, not a standard benchmark row. Companion developer post (developer.meta.com/ai/resources/blog/build-with-muse-code) and the Evaluation Methodology post are follow-up sources. Predecessor muse-spark-1-1 already in library; per Meta's page the pair share the 1M-token context window. vals.ai independently measured Spark 1.2 at 86.6% SWE-bench Verified on 2026-08-06 (tier C, noted for triangulation only).
